parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: The Quickbase table identifier to query.

schema.description: The Quickbase table identifier to query.

parameters.description: Optional array of Quickbase field IDs to return. Leave empty to use the table's default columns.

schema.description: Optional array of Quickbase field IDs to return. Leave empty to use the table's default columns.

parameters.description: Optional Quickbase query-language filter string, for example {'6'.CT.'Acme'}.

parameters.name: sortBy[]

schema.description: Optional array of group objects, each with fieldId and grouping.

parameters.description: Optional object containing runQuery options such as top, skip, and compareWithAppLocalTime.

schema.description: Optional object containing runQuery options such as top, skip, and compareWithAppLocalTime.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

fields.description: Metadata for the fields included in the result.
